answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 30393 Country: India Title: What about offering salat behind a salafi/ahl-e-hadith imam.is it good? Question: what about offering salat behind a salafi/ahl-e-hadith imam.is it good? Answer ID: 30393 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 239/222/B=1432) If he does not consider taqleed shirk and does not abuse Imam Abu Hanifa (رحمة الله عليه), the Fuqaha and Ulama and takes care of Ahnaf in the masael of water, wudhu and ghusl, then you can offer salah behind him. Otherwise, salah would be makrooh tahrimi behind him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
